facts.text: Jon is starting a dance studio as his dream business after losing his job.

evidence.quote: Losing my job gave me the push to finally start my dream business: my own dance studio!

facts.text: Jon finds dancing to be a stress-buster and a source of personal fulfillment.

evidence.quote: It's been my stress-buster since childhood!
It's a bit scary, but I just think about my love for dance and how it makes me feel.
Dancing helps me de-stress. It's where I'm most alive.

facts.text: Gina also finds dance to be a stress reliever and an essential part of her life.

evidence.quote: Dance is my stress fix too. As soon as I start, all my worries vanish.
